title: split lib/monitor.sh under the 250-line cap
objective: Move monitor.sh's eleven _check_* probes into two sibling libraries so every resulting file is under 250 lines, with monitoring behaviour byte-identical.
acceptance_criteria: test_monitor.sh reports exactly 9 passed, 0 failed — the same count as before the split
verify_shell_split.sh reports all 25 top-level functions moved verbatim
run_phone.sh --help exits 0, proving the source chain resolves in the real consumer
shellcheck is clean on each of the three files checked standing alone, with no suppressions
check_file_length.sh --all drops from 24 over-cap files to 23, with no new file over the cap
out_of_scope: deploy.sh copy lists: lib/monitor.sh is PC-side and deploy.sh never references lib/
Any behavioural change to the probes themselves
Running the probes against a real device
